title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
statement: Given an integer array `nums`, return `YES` if you can partition the array into two subsets such that the sum of the elements in both subsets is equal, or `NO` otherwise.
inputFormat:
Line 1: an integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.

starterCode.python:
n = int(input())
nums = list(map(int, input().split()))
